name: mirage
text: Those three Khaman Maluach Under 0.5 (3-pointers) bets of $2.69 each were pregame, before the 10:05 tip: 9:51:34, 9:52:09 and 9:57:05 PM. The third was placed through the Bet sheet on your phone (a by-hand tap, 4.5 stars, +4.5% EV at -130). The first two the phone logged as imported fills, meaning Novig had them but this phone didn't place them. They are not in the GitHub engine's order ledger either, which does show its other orders from those same minutes, so I can't see the engine or the auto-bet placing them. Do you remember tapping Bet in the Novig app or the web at 9:51? By-hand bets skip the repeat guard (your rule: hand bets are only warned), which is why a third tap went through. If you did not place the first two, tell me and I'll look for what did.
